title: Length of a snapshot encoding
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the binary alphabet, and let $s$ be a snapshot of $M$. The bit-string encoding of $s$ has length equal to the number of possible snapshots of $M$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over the binary alphabet
